name: dobot_stop

safetyNotes: A light desktop arm's axis servos are tuned for an expected end-effector mass. Swapping to a materially heavier or lighter tool than that tuning assumes can produce vibration or unstable motion — verify empirically at reduced speed before running unattended, and treat load/tuning changes as a safety-relevant event, not a cosmetic one.

Prefer the controller's remote-I/O / physical-button execution path over its interactive script runner for repeated or unattended runs; script-runner behavior was observed to be less consistent during calibration on this installation.

A frame (tool frame / user frame) edit may not take effect reliably until the controller connection is cycled. After any frame edit: save, reconnect or power-cycle, run a small axis-marker move, and only then attempt a full program.
Treat the physical motion and print result as ground truth over any live IDE coordinate readout or software preview.
